title_en: Gjurga Lay Down on the Level Threshing Floor
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'Танка је топола' has an odd 'је' which I read as a dialect 'as/like' (my reading); the last line turns the refrain into an insult.

lines.en: Gjurga lay down on the level threshing floor.

lines.cyr: - Ѓурѓо ле! Ѓурѓа глава не крева,
lines.lat: - Ǵurǵo le! Ǵurǵa glava ne kreva,
lines.en: - Oh Gjurga! Gjurga does not lift her head,
oh my, Gjurga won't get up.
On the level threshing floor, in the moonlight.
